# BHOOMI Paddy Pest Dataset v4.0 — Contents

## Knowledge / decision data
- pest_records.json / pest_records.csv
- severity_framework.json
- pest_corpus_collection_plan.csv
- validation_roadmap.csv
- source_snapshot.json

## Image data
- images/ — 17 actual TNAU-sourced image files
- image_manifest.csv — image-level provenance, hashes, labels and validation flags
- vision_label_schema.json — future vision annotation schema
- IMAGE_DATASET_README.md — image limitations and rights note

## Image coverage
Stem borer 3; Brown planthopper 3; Leaf folder 3; Green leafhopper 2; Gall midge 2; Thrips 2; Earhead bug 2; Whorl maggot 0.

## Production status
Text: curated seed corpus / validation required.
Images: reference/seed image set / expert annotation and rights verification required.
Vision model: not included.
